title: For ports whose status is DOWN and that also have a standard attribute ID a
question: For ports whose status is DOWN and that also have a standard attribute ID above the average for their resource type, list each port’s port ID and tenant ID along with host, VIF type, allocated IP address, the IP-address-ordered row number (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports, the overall average DOWN-port count benchmark and the tenant usage category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER), plus the port’s MAC address and the running sum of standard attribute IDs within its resource type. Do not return any rounded answers. Classify the tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.mac_address,
    p.standard_attr_id,
    b.host,
    b.vif_type,
    ia.ip_address,
    sa.resource_type
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
resource_avg AS (
  SELECT resource_type, AVG(standard_attr_id) AS avg_attr_id
  FROM base
  GROUP BY resource_type
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN resource_avg ra ON b.resource_type = ra.resource_type
  WHERE b.standard_attr_id > ra.avg_attr_id
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ip_address ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS ip_row_num,
    SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY resource_type ORDER BY ip_address) AS running_sum_attr_id
  FROM filtered
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(port_id) AS down_port_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_count
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT
  w.port_id,
  w.tenant_id,
  w.host,
  w.vif_type,
  w.ip_address,
  w.ip_row_num,
  tc.down_port_count AS tenant_down_ports,
  oa.avg_down_count AS overall_avg_down,
  CASE
    WHEN tc.down_port_count > oa.avg_down_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
    WHEN tc.down_port_count < oa.avg_down_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
  END AS usage_category,
  w.mac_address,
  w.running_sum_attr_id
FROM windowed w
JOIN tenant_counts tc ON w.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.standard_attr_id,
         b.host, b.vif_type, a.ip_address, s.resource_type
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes s ON s.id = p.standard_attr_id
  LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations a ON a.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
rt_avg AS (
  SELECT resource_type, AVG(standard_attr_id) AS avg_attr
  FROM base
  GROUP BY resource_type
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT b.*, b.standard_attr_id > r.avg_attr AS above
  FROM base b JOIN rt_avg r ON r.resource_type = b.resource_type
),
tenant_down AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_count
  FROM ports WHERE status='DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(down_count) AS avg_down FROM tenant_down
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT f.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.tenant_id ORDER BY f.ip_address) AS ip_row_number,
         SUM(f.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY f.resource_type ORDER BY f.ip_address
             ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS running_sum_attr
  FROM filtered f
)
SELECT r.port_id, r.tenant_id, r.host, r.vif_type, r.ip_address,
       r.ip_row_number,
       t.down_count AS tenant_down_count,
       o.avg_down AS overall_avg_down,
       CASE
         WHEN t.down_count >= o.avg_down * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
         WHEN t.down_count <= o.avg_down * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
       END AS tenant_usage_category,
       r.mac_address,
       r.running_sum_attr
FROM ranked r
JOIN tenant_down t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.above = 1;
